title: qwen-launcher calibration-report/v1
description: Privacy-reviewed evidence and candidate selection produced by calibration/v1.

schema.description: Versioned schema identifier for this calibration report.

id.description: Stable report identifier, equal to the file name without its extension.

created_at.description: UTC date and time when the report bundle was generated.

decision.description: Human review decision for this report.

launcher_version.description: Exact qwen-launcher version that generated the report.

model.description: Complete model identifier used for calibration.

engine.description: Exact llama.cpp release used for calibration.

engine_source_commit.description: Full source commit of the calibrated llama.cpp release.

calibration_protocol.description: Calibration protocol used to compare candidates.

benchmark_protocol.description: Benchmark protocol used for every valid candidate.

policy.description: Policy values and ordered candidates actually used for this run.

hardware.description: Privacy-safe hardware facts captured during calibration.

hardware_class.description: Approved hardware-class identifier, or null for a newly proposed class.

modes.description: Candidate results and selection keyed by calibrated mode identifier.

^[a-z0-9-]+$.description: Calibration results for one existing launcher mode.

selection_rule.description: Fixed calibration/v1 rule: maximize median tok/s, then free VRAM, then envelope prudence.

privacy_reviewed.description: Whether a human confirmed that the shared evidence contains no private data.

evidence_manifest.description: Relative path to the SHA-256 manifest for the evidence bundle.

privacy_reviewed.description: Accepted reports require completed human privacy review.

modes.description: Accepted reports require a selected candidate for every mode.

selected_candidate_id.description: Accepted candidate identifier required by the accepted-report branch.

modes.description: Draft and rejected reports cannot claim a selected candidate.

selected_candidate_id.description: Unaccepted modes retain a null candidate selection.

relative_path.description: Non-empty bundle-relative path checked semantically for traversal and absoluteness.

candidate.description: Candidate parameters recorded in the policy snapshot.

mode.description: Mode for which the candidate was tested.

id.description: Candidate identifier unique within its mode.

ctx.description: Context size tested by this candidate.

n_cpu_moe.description: Experts assigned to CPU on CUDA; required on CUDA and forbidden on CPU by semantic validation.

policy_snapshot.description: Exact calibration policy inputs used to produce this report.

id.description: Approved policy identifier, or null before a policy is approved.

gpu_poll_interval_ms.description: GPU memory polling interval used for the run.

gpu_release_stabilization_ms.description: Maximum post-stop stabilization window used for GPU memory release.

stable_start_runs.description: Required number of successful fresh starts per valid candidate.

minimum_free_vram_gib.description: Required free-VRAM reserve, or null for a CPU calibration.

vram_release_tolerance_gib.description: Accepted post-stop used-VRAM increase, or null for CPU calibration.

candidates.description: Candidates in the exact order in which calibration tested them.

items.description: Candidate parameters used by the run.

hardware.description: Hardware snapshot without hostname, username, or private paths.

os_version.description: Operating system version observed during calibration.

cpu_name.description: CPU model reported by the operating system.

cpu_cores.description: Number of logical CPU cores available to the launcher.

ram_total_gib.description: Total system RAM in exact GiB.

ram_available_gib.description: Available system RAM in exact GiB before calibration.

gpu_index.description: Selected physical GPU index, or null for CPU calibration.

gpu_name.description: Selected GPU model, or null for CPU calibration.

gpu_driver.description: GPU driver version, or null for CPU calibration.

vram_total_gib.description: Selected GPU total VRAM in exact GiB, or null for CPU calibration.

vram_free_gib.description: Selected GPU free VRAM before calibration, or null for CPU calibration.

tok_s.description: Token-per-second summary for five valid benchmark/v1 measurements.

log_digest.description: Digest of one relative calibration log included in the evidence bundle.

path.description: Bundle-relative path of the calibration log.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact log bytes.

candidate_result.description: Observed outcome and evidence for one calibration candidate.

id.description: Candidate identifier matching the policy snapshot.

ctx.description: Context size tested by this candidate.

n_cpu_moe.description: Experts assigned to CPU on CUDA; required on CUDA and forbidden on CPU by semantic validation.

outcome.description: Whether the candidate completed calibration or was discarded.

discard_reason.description: Actionable reason a discarded candidate failed the protocol.

successful_start_runs.description: Number of successful fresh process starts completed by the candidate.

vram_baseline_gib.description: Total GPU memory use before the candidate, or null on CPU.

vram_peak_gib.description: Peak total GPU memory use during the candidate, or null on CPU.

vram_min_free_gib.description: Minimum free GPU memory during the candidate, or null on CPU.

vram_release_used_gib.description: Aggregate used GPU memory at the accepted or final release sample, or null on CPU.

warmup_tok_s.description: Excluded benchmark warm-up token rate, or null if it did not complete.

measured_tok_s.description: Five valid benchmark rates, or partial/null evidence for a discarded candidate.

tok_s.description: Summary of the five valid measurements, or null when discarded.

log_digests.description: Digests of all relative logs supporting this candidate outcome.

items.description: One candidate log and its digest.

warmup_tok_s.description: Completed warm-up required for a valid candidate.

measured_tok_s.description: Exactly five measurements required for a valid candidate.

tok_s.description: Token-rate summary required for a valid candidate.

measured_tok_s.description: Discarded candidates may retain partial but never complete benchmark evidence.

tok_s.description: Discarded candidates cannot claim a benchmark summary.

mode_result.description: Candidate evidence and final selection for one calibrated mode.

candidates.description: Candidate results in the same order as the policy snapshot.

selected_candidate_id.description: Selected valid candidate identifier, or null until the mode is accepted.
